recentItems.title: Dieppe Raid 50th Anniversary Parade - 19AUG92
recentItems.description: Footage of the 19AUG92 parade in Dieppe, France commemorating the 50th anniversary of The Dieppe Raid.  The parade was led by the Band of the Royal Regiment of Canada under the direction of Major Gino Falconi CD Director of Music, and the late Drum Major CWO Ron Scott CD.  The audio doesn't fully capture the thunderous applause and cheers from the crowd for the veterans as they paraded through the town.
